steps.title: Log into Shopify Partners dashboard
steps.detail: Open https://partners.shopify.com and sign in with your Partner account credentials.

steps.title: Create a new app
steps.detail: In the dashboard sidebar select **Apps**, then click **Create app** and choose **Public app** (or the appropriate type).

steps.title: Enter basic app information
steps.detail: Provide an app name, App URL, and one or more Redirect URI(s). All Redirect URIs must be HTTPS and match exactly what your OAuth flow will use.

steps.title: Save to generate API credentials
steps.detail: Click **Save**. Shopify will display the **API key (Client ID)** and **API secret key** – copy these for your server configuration.

steps.title: Configure OAuth scopes
steps.detail: Under **Configuration → OAuth scopes**, select the permissions your app requires (e.g., read_products, write_orders). Save the changes.

steps.title: Submit the app for review
steps.detail: From the app’s overview page click **Submit for review** and follow the prompts to provide any required assets (screenshots, description, privacy policy).

citations.quote: After you make the changes, submit your response in the Partner Dashboard and provide evidence of the changes that you've made.
citations.title: App quality checks – Shopify Dev

steps.title: Monitor review status
steps.detail: All feedback and your responses are managed in the Partner Dashboard until the quality check process is complete.

nuances.title: Prerequisite install and review thresholds
nuances.detail: Shopify will not allow a public app to be listed unless it already has at least 50 net installs on paid‑plan shops, a minimum of five reviews, and meets the recent rating threshold.

citations.quote: Your app must have a minimum of 50 net installs from active shops on paid plans.

citations.quote: Your app must have a minimum of five reviews.
citations.title: App launch requirements – Shopify Dev

citations.title: App launch requirements – Shopify Dev

nuances.title: Redirect URI must be exact and HTTPS
nuances.detail: Shopify only accepts redirect URIs that use HTTPS and match the value sent in the OAuth request byte‑for‑byte; wildcards or query‑string variations are rejected.

nuances.title: Scope approval may be limited for new apps
nuances.detail: If your app requests sensitive scopes (e.g., write_orders), Shopify reviewers may ask for additional justification or limit the scopes until the app proves compliance.

whenBlocked.situation: App does not meet the 50‑install, 5‑review, or rating prerequisites
whenBlocked.action: You cannot submit the app for public listing. Focus on acquiring installs and reviews on a development store or private distribution, then re‑attempt submission.
whenBlocked.contact: Shopify Partner Support via https://help.shopify.com/partners or email partners@shopify.com

whenBlocked.action: Edit the app’s OAuth configuration in the Partner Dashboard to use an exact HTTPS URL that matches your OAuth flow, then resubmit.
